assertions.title: Shared tokens/themes render consistently in Storybook and web

steps.expected: Storybook preview imports shared styles from @platform/ui/styles and configures theme toggle decorator
steps.observed: preview.ts imports '@platform/ui/styles', defines globalTypes.theme with light/dark toolbar items, and a decorator that toggles .dark class on document.documentElement

steps.expected: Shared token layer with :root (light) and .dark CSS custom properties using oklch
steps.observed: Contains full oklch token set: :root defines light tokens (--background: oklch(1 0 0), --foreground: oklch(0.145 0 0), etc.), .dark selector overrides all tokens for dark theme (--background: oklch(0.145 0 0), --foreground: oklch(0.985 0 0), etc.), plus @theme inline block mapping to Tailwind

steps.expected: Web app imports shared styles from @platform/ui
steps.observed: Single line: @import '@platform/ui/styles.css' — web app delegates entirely to the shared package for tokens

steps.expected: Package exports ./styles and ./styles.css pointing to src/styles/index.css
Storybook loads with light theme by default
steps.observed: Storybook loaded successfully with light theme, toolbar shows 'Light' label, white canvas background with dark text components

steps.action: Screenshot Storybook in light mode (Docs + Default story)
steps.expected: Light background, dark foreground text, readable button component
steps.observed: White background, dark text on Button component and docs table, light theme tokens applied correctly

steps.action: Switch Storybook to dark theme via toolbar toggle
steps.expected: Canvas background becomes dark, text becomes light
steps.observed: Clicked 'Dark' in toolbar dropdown. Canvas background changed to dark/black, 'Button' text became white. Toolbar now shows 'Dark' label

steps.action: Screenshot Storybook in dark mode (Default story)
steps.observed: Black canvas background, white 'Button' text — dark tokens from shared styles applied correctly

steps.action: Navigate to web app at http://web.platform.localhost:1355
steps.expected: Web app loads in light mode with white background
steps.observed: Web app loaded with white background, dark ASCII art text, 'API Status' card with white background and border, 'Home' nav link and theme toggle icon in header

steps.action: Screenshot web app in light mode
steps.expected: Light theme: white background, dark text, light card surface
steps.observed: White background (--background: oklch(1 0 0)), dark foreground text, card with white surface and subtle border — matches shared token :root values

steps.action: Switch web app to dark mode via header theme toggle
steps.expected: Background becomes dark, text becomes light, card surface darkens
steps.observed: Clicked 'Toggle theme' button, selected 'Dark' from dropdown. Background changed to dark (--background: oklch(0.145 0 0)), text became light, card surface darkened with lighter border

steps.action: Screenshot web app in dark mode
steps.expected: Dark theme: dark background, light text, dark card surface
steps.observed: Dark background, white/light ASCII art text, darker card with 'API Status' text in light color — matches shared .dark token values
No errors from Storybook page errors check (agent-browser errors returned empty)

Convex WebSocket errors to 'wss://example-convex-url.invalid' (expected per task instructions — placeholder URL). Storybook MDX React hook errors from prior navigation (pre-existing Storybook docs addon issue, not theme-related). No theme-related errors.

evidence.consoleErrors: Storybook: none (errors check clean). Web: Convex placeholder WebSocket errors (expected, wss://example-convex-url.invalid), Storybook MDX React hook errors from prior navigation (pre-existing, not theme-related). No theme-related console errors in either app.

terminalEvidence.storybookPreview: apps/storybook/.storybook/preview.ts imports @platform/ui/styles, defines theme toolbar (light/dark), decorator toggles .dark class on documentElement
terminalEvidence.sharedStyles: packages/ui/src/styles/index.css contains canonical oklch tokens for :root (light) and .dark, with @theme inline Tailwind mapping and base layer styles
terminalEvidence.webBootstrap: apps/web/src/index.css is a single @import '@platform/ui/styles.css' — fully delegates to shared package
terminalEvidence.packageExports: packages/ui/package.json exports './styles' and './styles.css' both pointing to ./src/styles/index.css

summary: Tested 1 assertion (VAL-CROSS-002): PASS. Both Storybook and web app consume the same shared token/theme surface from packages/ui/src/styles/index.css. Storybook loads it via @platform/ui/styles import in preview.ts with a toolbar decorator toggling .dark class. Web app loads it via @import '@platform/ui/styles.css' in its index.css. Light/dark theme switching works consistently in both apps — light mode shows white backgrounds with dark text, dark mode shows dark backgrounds with light text, using the same oklch CSS custom properties. No theme-related console errors in either app.
